verdict.rationale: Smooth's core offering is an AI browser agent that takes natural-language tasks, e.g. `smooth_client.run("Go to google flights and find the cheapest flight...")`. Users can watch it live, take over, cancel or list tasks, and chain multi-step sessions, and one hands-on community report says a complex prompt was handled well. Delegation happens programmatically through the SDK, API or CLI, or indirectly via external agents like Claude Code, not through a conversational assistant built into a product UI. Missing for 10: an in-product chat or assistant interface, and broader independent corroboration of delegation quality.
